"consumed_at_ms" is null or (
        "claimed_by_user_id" is not null
        and "consumed_at_ms" >= "issued_at_ms"
        and "consumed_at_ms" < "expires_at_ms"
      )

organization_document_folders_system_met.name: organization_document_folders_system_metadata_check
organization_document_folders_system_met.value: ("system_kind" is null and "subject_user_id" is null) or ("system_kind" = 'profile_reports_root' and "parent_folder_id" is null and "subject_user_id" is null) or ("system_kind" = 'profile_reports_person' and "parent_folder_id" is not null and "subject_user_id" is not null)

organization_documents_subject_check.name: organization_documents_subject_check
organization_documents_subject_check.value: ("kind" = 'member_profile' and "subject_user_id" is not null) or ("kind" != 'member_profile' and "subject_user_id" is null)

organization_documents_draft_metadata_ch.name: organization_documents_draft_metadata_check
organization_documents_draft_metadata_ch.value: ("draft_content" is null and "draft_created_by" is null and "draft_created_at" is null) or ("draft_content" is not null and "draft_created_by" = 'center_agent' and "draft_created_at" is not null)

organization_documents_profile_report_me.name: organization_documents_profile_report_metadata_check
organization_documents_profile_report_me.value: ("kind" != 'member_profile' and "profile_report_date" is null and "profile_report_type" is null) or ("kind" = 'member_profile' and (("profile_report_date" is null and "profile_report_type" is null) or (length("profile_report_date") = 10 and "profile_report_type" = 'work_profile')))

organization_opportunities_identity_non_.name: organization_opportunities_identity_non_empty_check
organization_opportunities_identity_non_.value: length(trim("id")) > 0 and length(trim("organization_id")) > 0 and length(trim("recipient_user_id")) > 0 and length(trim("opportunity_key")) between 1 and 256 and length(trim("created_by_profile_id")) > 0 and ("source_native_delivery_id" is null or length(trim("source_native_delivery_id")) > 0)

organization_opportunities_content_lengt.name: organization_opportunities_content_length_check
organization_opportunities_content_lengt.value: length(trim("title")) between 1 and 160 and length(trim("observation")) between 1 and 1000 and length(trim("expected_benefit")) between 1 and 500 and length(trim("suggested_next_step")) between 1 and 500

organization_opportunities_evidence_chec.name: organization_opportunities_evidence_check
organization_opportunities_evidence_chec.value: length("evidence_json") between 3 and 8192 and json_valid("evidence_json") and json_type("evidence_json") = 'array' and json_array_length("evidence_json") between 1 and 8

organization_opportunities_status_check.name: organization_opportunities_status_check
organization_opportunities_status_check.value: ("status" = 'open' and "decided_by_user_id" is null and "decided_at_ms" is null) or ("status" in ('accepted', 'deferred', 'dismissed') and "decided_by_user_id" is not null and "decided_at_ms" is not null)

organization_skills_source_shape_check.name: organization_skills_source_shape_check
organization_skills_source_shape_check.value: ("source_kind" = 'created' and "source_repository" is null and "source_path" is null and "source_commit_sha" is null) or ("source_kind" = 'github' and "source_repository" is not null and "source_path" is not null and "source_commit_sha" is not null)

organization_working_language_attributio.name: organization_working_language_attribution_check
organization_working_language_attributio.value: ("mode" = 'automatic' and "updated_by_user_id" is null) or ("mode" = 'selected' and "updated_by_user_id" is not null)

organizations_personal_created_by_user_u.name: organizations_personal_created_by_user_uidx
organizations_personal_created_by_user_u.where: "organizations"."created_by_user_id" is not null and case when json_valid("organizations"."metadata") then json_extract("organizations"."metadata", '$.personal') else 0 end = 1

projects_slug_shape_check.name: projects_slug_shape_check
projects_slug_shape_check.value:
length("slug") > 0
        and "slug" = lower("slug")
        and "slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*'
        and "slug" not like '-%'
        and "slug" not like '%-'
        and "slug" not like '%--%'

projects_repository_fingerprint_shape_ch.name: projects_repository_fingerprint_shape_check
projects_repository_fingerprint_shape_ch.value:
"repository_fingerprint" is null or (
        length("repository_fingerprint") = 71
        and substr("repository_fingerprint", 1, 7) = 'sha256:'
        and substr("repository_fingerprint", 8) not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'
      )

projects_repository_url_shape_check.name: projects_repository_url_shape_check
projects_repository_url_shape_check.value:
"repository_url" is null or (
        "repository_url" like 'https://%'
        and "repository_url" not like '%@%'
        and "repository_url" not like '%?%'
        and "repository_url" not like '%#%'
      )

routine_runs_finished_at_valid_check.name: routine_runs_finished_at_valid_check
routine_runs_finished_at_valid_check.value: "finished_at_ms" is null or "started_at_ms" is null or "finished_at_ms" >= "started_at_ms"

routines_schedule_fields_check.name: routines_schedule_fields_check
routines_schedule_fields_check.value: ("schedule_kind" = 'cron' and "cron_expression" is not null and "timezone" is not null and "run_at_ms" is null) or ("schedule_kind" = 'once' and "cron_expression" is null and "timezone" is null and "run_at_ms" is not null)

routines_destination_fields_check.name: routines_destination_fields_check
routines_destination_fields_check.value: ("destination_kind" = 'space' and "target_space_id" is not null and "slack_team_id" is null and "slack_channel_id" is null and "slack_thread_ts" is null and "slack_conversation_id" is null) or ("destination_kind" = 'slack_thread' and "target_space_id" is null and "slack_team_id" is not null and "slack_channel_id" is not null and "slack_thread_ts" is not null and "slack_conversation_id" is not null)

routines_status_next_due_check.name: routines_status_next_due_check
routines_status_next_due_check.value: ("status" = 'enabled' and "next_due_at" is not null) or ("status" in ('paused', 'completed') and "next_due_at" is null)

slack_channel_introduction_items_identit.name: slack_channel_introduction_items_identity_check
slack_channel_introduction_items_identit.value:
length(trim("interaction_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("slack_channel_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("slack_channel_name")) > 0
        AND "position" >= 0

slack_channel_introduction_items_outcome.name: slack_channel_introduction_items_outcome_shape_check
slack_channel_introduction_items_outcome.value:
(
        ("status" = 'ready' AND "claim_id" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'submitting' AND length(trim("claim_id")) > 0 AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'submitted' AND "claim_id" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" IN ('failed', 'outcome_unknown') AND "claim_id" IS NULL AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
      )

slack_channel_introduction_runs_identity.name: slack_channel_introduction_runs_identity_check
slack_channel_introduction_runs_identity.value:
length(trim("interaction_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("manifest_creation_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("slack_team_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("organization_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("requester_slack_user_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("dm_channel_id")) > 0
        AND ("organization_invite_url" IS NULL OR length(trim("organization_invite_url")) > 0)

slack_channel_introduction_runs_outcome_.name: slack_channel_introduction_runs_outcome_shape_check
slack_channel_introduction_runs_outcome_.value:
(
        "recovery_notice_attempt_count" >= 0
        AND (
          ("status" = 'ack_pending' AND "acknowledgement_ts" IS NULL AND "recovery_notice_ts" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("status" = 'ready' AND length(trim("acknowledgement_ts")) > 0 AND "recovery_notice_ts" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("status" IN ('failed', 'outcome_unknown') AND "acknowledgement_ts" IS NULL AND "recovery_notice_ts" IS NULL AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
          OR ("status" IN ('recovery_notice_pending', 'recovery_notice_submitting', 'recovery_notice_failed', 'recovery_notice_outcome_unknown') AND "acknowledgement_ts" IS NULL AND "recovery_notice_ts" IS NULL AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
          OR ("status" = 'recovery_notice_delivered' AND "acknowledgement_ts" IS NULL AND length(trim("recovery_notice_ts")) > 0 AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
        )
      )

slack_installation_welcome_outcome_shape.name: slack_installation_welcome_outcome_shape_check
slack_installation_welcome_outcome_shape.value:
(
        ("status" = 'pending' AND "message_ts" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR (
          "status" = 'delivered'
          AND length(trim("message_ts")) > 0
          AND "failure_code" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "status" in ('failed', 'outcome_unknown')
          AND "message_ts" IS NULL
          AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0
        )
      )

slack_installation_welcome_preparation_i.name: slack_installation_welcome_preparation_identity_check
slack_installation_welcome_preparation_i.value:
length(trim("slack_team_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("organization_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("recipient_slack_user_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("installed_by_user_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("installed_by_profile_id")) > 0

slack_installation_welcome_preparation_s.name: slack_installation_welcome_preparation_shape_check
slack_installation_welcome_preparation_s.value:
(
        ("status" = 'queued' AND "claim_id" IS NULL AND "research_task_id" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'researching' AND length(trim("claim_id")) > 0 AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'ready' AND length(trim("claim_id")) > 0 AND length(trim("research_task_id")) > 0 AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'completed' AND length(trim("claim_id")) > 0 AND length(trim("research_task_id")) > 0 AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'failed' AND length(trim("claim_id")) > 0 AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
      )

slack_invited_member_welcome_identity_ch.name: slack_invited_member_welcome_identity_check
slack_invited_member_welcome_identity_ch.value:
length(trim("interaction_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("target_slack_user_id")) > 0
        AND ("research_task_id" IS NULL OR length(trim("research_task_id")) > 0)
        AND length(trim("claim_id")) > 0

slack_invited_member_welcome_outcome_sha.name: slack_invited_member_welcome_outcome_shape_check
slack_invited_member_welcome_outcome_sha.value:
(
        ("status" = 'pending' AND "message_ts" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'delivered' AND length(trim("message_ts")) > 0 AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" IN ('failed', 'outcome_unknown') AND "message_ts" IS NULL AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
      )

slack_teammate_invitation_identity_check.name: slack_teammate_invitation_identity_check
slack_teammate_invitation_identity_check.value:
length(trim("interaction_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("slack_team_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("organization_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("actor_slack_user_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("actor_user_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("target_slack_user_id")) > 0
        AND length(trim("target_display_name")) > 0

slack_teammate_invitation_shape_check.name: slack_teammate_invitation_shape_check
slack_teammate_invitation_shape_check.value:
(
        ("status" = 'pending' AND "message_ts" IS NULL AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'delivered' AND length(trim("message_ts")) > 0 AND "failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" IN ('failed', 'outcome_unknown') AND "message_ts" IS NULL AND length(trim("failure_code")) > 0)
      )

slack_teammate_invitation_onboarding_sha.name: slack_teammate_invitation_onboarding_shape_check
slack_teammate_invitation_onboarding_sha.value:
(
        ("status" <> 'delivered'
          AND "onboarding_status" IS NULL
          AND "joined_user_id" IS NULL
          AND "joined_profile_id" IS NULL
          AND "research_task_id" IS NULL
          AND "welcome_message_ts" IS NULL
          AND "onboarding_failure_code" IS NULL)
        OR ("status" = 'delivered' AND (
          ("onboarding_status" = 'waiting_for_join'
            AND "joined_user_id" IS NULL
            AND "joined_profile_id" IS NULL
            AND "research_task_id" IS NULL
            AND "welcome_message_ts" IS NULL
            AND "onboarding_failure_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("onboarding_status" = 'starting'
            AND length(trim("joined_user_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("joined_profile_id")) > 0
            AND "research_task_id" IS NULL
            AND "welcome_message_ts" IS NULL
            AND "onboarding_failure_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("onboarding_status" = 'researching'
            AND length(trim("joined_user_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("joined_profile_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("research_task_id")) > 0
            AND "welcome_message_ts" IS NULL
            AND "onboarding_failure_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("onboarding_status" = 'completed'
            AND length(trim("joined_user_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("joined_profile_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("research_task_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("welcome_message_ts")) > 0
            AND "onboarding_failure_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("onboarding_status" = 'failed'
            AND length(trim("joined_user_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("joined_profile_id")) > 0
            AND length(trim("onboarding_failure_code")) > 0)
        ))
      )
